service_boundary: Represents the mainland-China Volcengine Ark platform, whose licence limits use to mainland China, not the international BytePlus ModelArk service, ByteDance consumer products, or individual Doubao model releases.
regional_controls: All documented endpoints are in one mainland region and the platform terms grant a licence to use the service only within mainland China. Private network access is available through virtual-network endpoints without changing the request address.
retention_controls: Platform terms commit to not storing or training on customer data without separate consent, naming exceptions for compliance filtering, customer-requested troubleshooting, and abnormal-invocation alerts. A sandbox tier keeps data from reaching third-party model publishers, and customers may hold their own encryption keys. Individual-edition subscription plans reverse this default and authorise storage and training use of inputs and outputs, withdrawable only by leaving the plan.
routing: Customers select a model or endpoint identifier. A routing model can auto-select among a customer-scoped model set by prompt, quality, and cost preference, limited to the chat interface and shorter contexts. Reserved throughput takes priority and spills over to the shared pool.
customization: Supervised, preference, and continued-pretraining tuning with datasets and evaluation jobs; tuned and customer-uploaded open-weight models deploy on dedicated units, including quantised variants.
strengths: Platform terms state a no-storage, no-training default and enumerate each exception, with published and effective dates.
Four serving modes span shared on-demand, reserved throughput, dedicated units with elastic scaling, and discounted batch.
Serves first-party models alongside separately contracted third-party publishers and accepts customer-uploaded open-weight models.
tradeoffs: The service licence is restricted to mainland China and only one region is documented.
Individual-edition subscription plans authorise storage and training use of prompts and outputs, with no withdrawal short of leaving the plan.
Documentation is Chinese only and several catalogue pages return empty bodies over HTTP.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Volcengine Ark context API documentation, for Volcengine Ark

upstream_disclosure.note: The platform terms state who receives data: "高阶安全防护即火山引擎为您提供的安全沙箱安全互信方案，保护您的数据不会被提供给模型服务商。如您选择使用不具备高阶安全防护的模型服务，那么您的数据处理规则将遵循您接受的模型服务协议与规则的约定。" (advanced security protection is a sandbox scheme under which your data is not provided to the model provider; for model services without it, the model provider's own agreement governs your data).
upstream_disclosure.scope: Volcengine Ark platform terms, for Volcengine Ark

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied-key path: every documented request authenticates with a Volcengine-issued key ("Authorization: Bearer $ARK_API_KEY").
credential_handling.scope: Volcengine Ark context API documentation, for Volcengine Ark

cache_isolation.note: The platform terms state where cached data lives: "您理解您的数据将会存储在火山方舟平台为您提供的存储空间中以实现您对数据缓存存储、监控观测、加标识、Agents 托管等目的。" (your data is stored in the storage space the Ark platform provides for you, for cache storage, monitoring, labelling, and agent hosting). The terms describe per-customer storage rather than cache-key behaviour.
cache_isolation.scope: Volcengine Ark platform terms, for Volcengine Ark

vulnerability_disclosure.note: ByteDance's security response centre, which covers Volcengine, publishes a vulnerability submission route ("提交漏洞") and the mailbox security@bytedance.com; it is company-wide rather than named for Ark.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: ByteDance security response centre, for Volcengine Ark

independent_audit.note: The Volcengine trust and compliance page lists company certifications and does not name Ark, so it is recorded as undocumented for the named service.
independent_audit.scope: Volcengine trust and compliance page, read for Volcengine Ark
